title: Cold gas disks in main-sequence galaxies at cosmic noon: Low turbulence, flat rotation curves, and disk-halo degeneracy
question: What are the internal cold gas kinematics (turbulence, rotation curve shapes) and dark matter versus baryonic mass distributions in two main-sequence galaxies at cosmic noon?

what.value: Stellar masses and star-formation rates from SED fitting

evidence.quote: (cite: Liu2019) provide the stellar mass ($M_\star$) and star-formation rate (SFRs) of both galaxies by fitting their spectral energy distributions (SEDs), combining optical and NIR photometry from COSMOS with the ALMA submillimeter continuum.

what.value: Average CO line excitation ratios R_21=0.85 and R_31=0.60

evidence.quote: Adopting the average line ratios $R_{21}=L_{\rm CO(2-1)}/L_{\rm CO(1-0)}\simeq0.85$ and $R_{31}=L_{\rm CO(3-2)}/L_{\rm CO (1-0)}\simeq0.60$ (cite: Bisbas2021), we find $M_{\rm gas}\simeq10^{10}-10^{11}$ M$_\odot$ assuming either a starburst-like conversion factor $\alpha_{\rm CO}\simeq0.4$ M$_\odot$ (K km s$^{-1}$ pc$^2$)$^{-1}$ or the Milky Way $\alpha_{\rm CO}\simeq4.3$ M$_\odot$ (K km s$^{-1}$ pc$^2$)$^{-1}$.

what.value: Gas-to-stellar disk mass ratio prior centered at log(mu_gas)=0

evidence.quote: Considering the results of (cite: Tacconi2018) and (cite: Liu2019b) for galaxies at $z\simeq1.5-2.5$, we center the prior at $\log(\mu_{\rm gas})=0$ with a standard deviation of 0.3 dex.

what.value: Stellar-to-halo mass relation (M_star - M_200) at z=[1.1-1.5] and z=[2.0-2.5]

evidence.loc: Mass models adding a dark matter halo
evidence.quote: Specifically, we impose the $M_\star-M_{200}$ relations derived by (cite: Legrand2019) at $z=[1.1-1.5]$ and $z=[2.0-2.5]$ on zC-488879 and zC-400569, respectively.

what.value: Halo mass-concentration (M_200 - C_200) relation at z~1 and z~2

evidence.loc: Mass models adding a dark matter halo
evidence.quote: Similarly, the mass-concentration relations from (cite: Dutton2014) at $z\simeq1$ and $z\simeq2$ are imposed on zC-488879 and zC-400569, respectively.

what.value: SPARC sample local galaxy rotation curves and radial acceleration relation

evidence.quote: To illustrate the situation, Figure [10](#fig:SPARC) compares the rotation curves of zC-400569 and zC-488879 with those of local galaxies from the SPARC sample (cite: Lelli2016b).

evidence.loc: The dark matter effect: Probing low accelerations
evidence.quote: To illustrate the situation, Figure [11](#fig:RAR) shows the location of zC-400569 and zC-299569 on the empirical RAR at $z\simeq0$ (cite: McGaugh2016; Lelli2017): the observed centripetal acceleration from rotation curves ($g_{\rm obs}=V_{\rm rot}^2/R$) is plotted against that expected from the distribution of baryons ($g_{\rm bar} = -\nabla \phi_{\rm bar}$).

recipe.goal: Smooth ALMA emission-line cubes, generate masks and moment maps, and measure integrated line fluxes
recipe.method: Hanning smooth cubes over 3 channels, create Boolean masks with Smooth & Search, generate moment maps with Makemask, build S/N map accounting for channel dependencies, and sum pixels with S/N > 3 for total flux
key_parameters: Hanning smoothing over 3 channels to 30 km s^-1 resolution
Smooth & Search parameters: Factor=1.5, Snrcut=4, Growthcut=3, Minchannels=3

recipe.goal: Prepare archival SINFONI H-alpha cube for zC-400569
recipe.method: Add WCS, convert spectral axis to velocity, rotate 30 deg counterclockwise to align with north, resample to 0.05'' pixels, subtract continuum using first-order polynomial fit to line-free channels, and extract H-alpha sub-cube
key_parameters: Pixel size = 0.05'', PSF FWHM ~ 0.32'', LSF FWHM = 87 km s^-1 (sigma_inst ~ 37 km s^-1)

recipe.goal: Extract stellar surface brightness profiles and decompose into morphological components
recipe.method: Fit elliptical isophotes to HST WFC3 F160W images to derive azimuthally averaged surface brightness profiles, then fit multicomponent galaxy models (de Vaucouleurs bulge + exponential disk, plus Sersic n=0.2 lens for zC-488879)
key_parameters: Sersic index n = 0.2 for lens component in zC-488879
assumptions: Bulge profile extrapolated below HST PSF (~0.15'' or ~1.3 kpc)

recipe.goal: Determine disk geometry from 3D tilted-ring modeling
recipe.method: Run 3Dfit in 3DBAROLO on each cube with 7 free parameters per ring and uniform weighting; take median and MAD across all rings and CO lines to fix disk geometry
key_parameters: Ring width = sqrt(a * b) / 2; Norm=Azim; Ltype=3 (exponential vertical profile with z_0 = 100 pc); V_rad = 0; Wfunc=0
Initial guesses: PA=35 deg, i=50 deg for zC-400569; PA=-20 deg, V_sys=50 km s^-1 for zC-488879
assumptions: Fully axisymmetric disk without warps; radial velocity V_rad = 0; exponential vertical scale height z_0 = 100 pc

recipe.method: Explore V_rot - sigma_V grid in 1 km s^-1 steps using SpacePar task in 3DBAROLO with fixed geometry; validate upper limit using mock-observed cubes and 10 km s^-1 resolution cubes
key_parameters: Step size = 1 km s^-1, sigma_V range = 1 to 60 km s^-1, V_rot range = 200 km s^-1; Ftype=2 (and tested Ftype=3); Wfunc=0

recipe.goal: Derive rotation curves for each emission line
recipe.method: Run 3Dfit in 3DBAROLO with only V_rot free per ring, fixing geometry and fixing velocity dispersion to its upper limit, weighting pixels by cos^2(theta)
key_parameters: Wfunc=2 (cos^2(theta) weighting); sigma_CO fixed to 15 km s^-1; sigma_Halpha fixed to 37 km s^-1
assumptions: Negligible asymmetric drift (pressure support) since V_rot / sigma_CO >= 17-22

recipe.goal: Compute baryonic gravitational velocity contributions and fit dynamical mass models (Baryons-only, Baryons+NFW, MOND)
recipe.method: Compute V_bul, V_disk, and V_gas for unit mass (10^10 M_sun) using ROTMOD in Gipsy, then fit combined multi-line rotation curves with MCMC in emcee under three frameworks: Baryons only, Baryons + NFW halo, and MOND
key_parameters: emcee: 200 walkers, 1000 burn-in iterations, 2000 production iterations, stretch move parameter a = 2
Gas disk radial profile from CO(3-2) for zC-400569 and CO(2-1) for zC-488879; exponential vertical profile with scale height 100 pc
assumptions: Flat LambdaCDM cosmology: H_0 = 67.4 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_m = 0.315, Omega_Lambda = 0.685
Spherical bulge; exponential vertical stellar disk with z_disk = 0.196 (R_e,disk / 1.68)^0.633; negligible HI contribution in inner CO-bright regions
MOND model assumes a_0 = 1.2 x 10^-10 m s^-2, LambdaCDM D_A-z relation, and z~0 RAR interpolation function

score_reason: All datasets (ALMA, SINFONI, HST) are public with exact IDs/URLs, software versions (CASA 6.1.2.7, 3DBAROLO 1.6) are specified, and the 3DBAROLO task options, MCMC setup, and Bayesian priors are documented in exceptional detail; only minor tclean imaging parameters and intermediate radial profile tables are omitted.
rediscovery_reason: Public archival data across ALMA, HST, and SINFONI with a very clear, step-by-step recipe in 3DBAROLO and emcee leading to well-defined numeric rotation velocities, dispersions, and mass model parameters.
